Mixed macro backdrop with [[pos:strong earnings growth]] across mega-caps but [[warn:elevated valuations]] on several names. IV ranges from [[key:21.7% (COST)]] to [[key:60.6% (NFLX)]] creating varied premium opportunities. [[pos:TSLA/NFLX high IV]] favors defined-risk spreads; [[pos:MSFT/COST low IV]] suits cash-secured puts. Top setups: TSLA 10d $327.50 put / $397.50 call strangle and GOOG 21d $315 put / $375 call for balanced theta.

Market shows [[pos:divergent IV regimes]]: mega-cap indices (VOO, SPYV) trade at low volatility while semiconductors (INTC 72%, AMD 59%, NVDA 39%) and META (62%) offer elevated premiums. [[key:INTC $85 put]] and [[key:META $662.50 put]] stand out as high-conviction sell-put candidates given wide expected ranges and attractive annualized returns. [[warn:INTC fundamentals deteriorating]] with negative EPS; [[warn:META regulatory overhang]] persists. VOO and SPYV lack sufficient options data for high-confidence trades. [[pos:TSM analyst bullish consensus]] supports put selling at $380. [[neg:ABNB mixed analyst views]] warrant caution.

Market shows mixed sentiment with healthcare ([[pos:UNH near-fair]]) vs tech ([[warn:AVGO ISRG MRVL overvalued]]). IV elevated across board: MRVL 68.4%, ISRG 64.2%, SPCX 53.8%. Top setups: UNH $375 put (21d) for [[pos:defined risk near support]], MRVL $260 call (21d) capturing [[key:high premium]]. Key risks: [[warn:extreme IV in semis/medtech]], wide spreads, and stretched valuations.
